source: ESPN live injury report (site.api.espn.com/.../nfl/injuries) - see get_espn_injuries.py
methodology_note: Real, disclosed scope: confirmed Out/Injured Reserve players are shown with adjusted_projected_ppr=0.0 (a real fact - they won't play). Questionable players are flagged but NOT numerically adjusted - no real, fit model exists in this project for how much a game-status designation should reduce a projection, so none was invented. Backup players are NOT boosted for the same reason - no real model exists for how much workload/points a backup absorbs when a starter is out. This is a real, separate overlay - it does not modify player_props_2026.json, fantasy_rankings_2026.json, games_2026.json, or data/locked_predictions/.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.source_note: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) will "most likely not" have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 8, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.source_note: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
players.source_note: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Jack Bech
players.source_note: The Raiders designated Bech (forearm) for return from injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Cole Kmet
players.source_note: The Bears placed Kmet (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Tanner Hudson
players.source_note: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

players.name: Tyler Badie
players.source_note: The Broncos placed Badie (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Brashard Smith

players.name: James Conner
players.source_note: When asked Monday if Conner (foot) will play this season, coach Mike LaFleur said "potentially," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.source_note: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.source_note: Head coach Todd Bowles said Egbuka (concussion/foot) took part in individual drills Wednesday, but the wide receiver will need to do more Thursday to progress toward a return to action, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

players.name: Braelon Allen

players.name: Cam Skattebo
